pages.title: Dawn Armor
pages.text: §lCrafting: §r Smithing Table: Dawn Template + matching iron armor + Iron Ingot. Each of the four pieces is forged separately. Dawn Templates can be found in loot chests.$(br2)§lStats: §r Armor 3 / 10 / 8 / 4 (helmet / chestplate / leggings / boots), toughness 6.25, knockback resistance 0.25, durability 2500, fire resistant.$(br2)§lBuilt-in enchantments: §r Protection III, Fire Protection III, Projectile Protection III, Blast Protection III, Durability Boost II.

pages.title: Dawn Helmet
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Helmet + Iron Ingot. Armor 3.

pages.title: Dawn Chestplate
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Chestplate + Iron Ingot. Armor 10.

pages.title: Dawn Leggings
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Leggings + Iron Ingot. Armor 8.

pages.title: Dawn Boots
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Boots + Iron Ingot. Armor 4.
